summary: Images or gradients painted behind the content, above the background colour.
details: Gradients are images: linear-gradient(), radial-gradient() and conic-gradient() need no file at all. You can stack several, separated by commas; the first one listed is painted on top.

values.note: Light in the middle, fading outwards.
Two layers: a dark fade over a gradient.

gotcha: A background image does not give the element any size. An empty div with only a background image is 0px tall; give it a height, an aspect-ratio or content.
